items.name: Trade Republic
items.etfSparplaeneCaveat: Provider and test-portal figures range between roughly 2,700 and 2,827 fee-free ETF savings plans
items.guthabenzinsCaveat: Test portals cite 2.25% or 2.50% p.a. depending on the date checked (variable, tied to the ECB deposit rate)
items.ageLimitText: Can be opened up to age 17.5
items.besonderheitenText: Grandparents can contribute via a savings-sponsor feature
items.sourcesNote: Figures per capitalo.de and finanzfluss.de, as of October 2026

items.name: Scalable Capital
items.etfSparplaeneCaveat: Test portals cite between roughly 2,700 and 3,328 fee-free ETF savings plans depending on the date checked
items.guthabenzinsCaveat: Rate applies in the free FREE tier on balances up to €100,000
items.ageLimitText: Can be opened up to age 17
items.sourcesNote: Figures per capitalo.de and finanzfluss.de, as of October 2026

items.name: Consorsbank
items.etfSparplaeneCaveat: Test portals cite between roughly 1,860 and 2,004 fee-free ETF savings plans
items.guthabenzinsCaveat: Interest figures conflict: one source cites a 0.80% base rate plus a 3.40% new-customer promo for 5 months, another just 1% — please check current terms with the provider
items.ageLimitText: No age restriction for the opening parent is stated
items.sourcesNote: Figures per capitalo.de and finanzfluss.de, as of October 2026

items.name: comdirect
items.depotgebuehrText: €0/year for 6 months, then free with 2 trades/quarter or a running savings plan, otherwise €1.95/month
items.etfSparplaeneCaveat: Only around 550–600 of over 2,100 total savings plans are fee-free (the lowest free ratio in this comparison)
items.guthabenzinsCaveat: Interest on the cash account is not stated by the test portals
items.ageLimitText: Original documents for account opening are sent by post
items.besonderheitenText: Test portal notes a 1.5% execution fee per order on ETF savings plans
items.sourcesNote: Figures per capitalo.de and finanzfluss.de, as of October 2026

items.name: flatex
items.etfSparplaeneCaveat: Test portals cite between roughly 2,364 and 2,506 plans — whether all are fee-free is not stated consistently
items.guthabenzinsCaveat: Interest on the cash account is not stated by the test portals
items.ageLimitText: Both parents need their own flatex account
items.besonderheitenText: Highest minimum savings rate in this comparison (€25)
items.sourcesNote: Figures per capitalo.de and finanzfluss.de, as of October 2026
